intro: A bowl of mee jawa is about 500 kcal (estimate). Most of the calories come from the yellow noodles and the thick sweet potato and peanut gravy.
diet: Yes, mee jawa works fine when you're trying to lose weight, with a normal portion. The thick sweet potato and peanut gravy is really filling. What usually pushes the calories up is extra cucur udang and crackers. One bowl without add-ons is already a complete meal.
tips: Skip the cucur udang or share it with a friend.
Add taugeh and squeeze in limau kasturi for freshness without extra calories.
No need to finish all the gravy. Leave a bit at the bottom of the bowl.

swap.name: Mee rebus ayam without cucur
swap.why: Tastes quite similar, the gravy is a little lighter, and you can add chicken for protein.

faq.q: What's the difference between mee jawa and mee rebus?
faq.a: They're very similar. Mee jawa gravy is usually sweeter and has peanuts, while mee rebus uses more sweet potato and beef.

faq.q: Why is mee jawa gravy so thick?
faq.a: The gravy is thickened with mashed sweet potato or tapioca, sometimes with a little flour.

faq.q: Where does mee jawa come from?
faq.a: It was brought over by Javanese communities who migrated to Malaya, and it's now popular all over Malaysia.
